description: This file defines the StateContainer class, which manages session-based state information for the installer component of the OrangeHRM system, including database info, current screen, version, and admin data.

classes.name: StateContainer
classes.description: A singleton class that manages session-based state information for the installer process, including database configuration, current step, version, admin data, and migration status.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the StateContainer.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets a session attribute with the given name and value.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a session attribute by name, with an optional default.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a session attribute exists.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes a session attribute.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Returns all session attributes.

methods.name: storeDbInfo
methods.description: Stores database connection info and optional encryption setting into session.

methods.name: getDbInfo
methods.description: Retrieves stored database connection info from session.

methods.name: clearDbInfo
methods.description: Clears stored database connection info from session.

methods.name: isSetDbInfo
methods.description: Checks if database info has been set.

methods.name: setDbType
methods.description: Sets the database type in session.

methods.name: getDbType
methods.description: Retrieves the database type from session.

methods.name: setCurrentScreen
methods.description: Sets the current installer screen and whether it's an upgrader process.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Gets the current installer screen.

methods.name: isUpgrader
methods.description: Checks if the current process is an upgrader.

methods.name: setCurrentVersion
methods.description: Sets the current version of the system.

methods.name: getCurrentVersion
methods.description: Gets the current version of the system.

methods.name: storeInstanceData
methods.description: Stores organization, country, language, and timezone info.

methods.name: getInstanceData
methods.description: Retrieves stored instance data.

methods.name: storeAdminUserData
methods.description: Stores admin user details.

methods.name: getAdminUserData
methods.description: Retrieves admin user details.

methods.name: storeRegConsent
methods.description: Stores registration consent status.

methods.name: getRegConsent
methods.description: Retrieves registration consent status.

methods.name: storeInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Stores an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifierData
methods.description: Retrieves the stored instance identifier.

methods.name: storeInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Stores initial registration data and related flags.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves initial registration data and flags.

methods.name: setMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Marks migration as completed.

methods.name: isMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Checks if migration has been completed.

methods.name: clearMigrationCompleted
methods.description: Clears migration completion status.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Invalidates session and resets state while preserving current screen and upgrader status.
